demo.title: coffer.sh
demo.code:
# Read the vault
bankr prompt "Using the coffer skill, what is the Coffer vault value?"
bankr prompt "Using the coffer skill, what pairs are in the Coffer vault?"
bankr prompt "Using the coffer skill, what are my Coffer shares?"

# Deposit ETH (routed across all legs; you do not pick a pair)
bankr prompt "Using the coffer skill, deposit 0.05 ETH into Coffer"

# Withdraw - burns liquid shares, pays WETH
bankr prompt "Using the coffer skill, withdraw 50% from Coffer"
bankr prompt "Using the coffer skill, withdraw all from Coffer"

setup: Chain: Robinhood (4663) - one vault, no factory; confirm the Bankr wallet supports 4663
Fund the wallet with ETH on Robinhood for deposits and gas
Deposits are ETH only; withdrawals burn liquid shares and pay WETH (aeWETH 0x0Bd7D308...)
Live pairs come from vault.strategies(i) - volatile leg quoted in WETH, stock legs (AMZN, GLD) quoted in USDG
Read-only: vault value, total shares, my shares, fees earned, rotating tokens (references/addresses.md)
This skill does not operate the keeper or rotate assets - user deposit/withdraw only
